name: serve
description: Share a file or directory over local HTTP. Spawns an http.server through the proc registry (manageable via proc list/kill), prints the URL, renders a QR code when qrencode is installed. Localhost by default; --lan for network sharing.
use_when: sharing files or artifacts over HTTP with the user or LAN

args.name: serve <path> [--port 0] [--lan]
args.description: Serve a file's dir or a directory; prints URL (+ QR when qrencode exists).

env.AGENT_TOOLS_HOME: State root; share procs register in <root>/procs/.

stdout: JSON {proc, url, dir, lan, stop, qr?} or running-share list.
notes: --lan binds 0.0.0.0 with no authentication — localhost is the default for a reason.
